revision_description: ferric local extension 2026-06-17: added d-block Sc-Zn(21-30) from aug-cc-pVTZ-RIFIT and alkalis Li/Na/K(3,11,19) from def2-TZVP-RIFIT (no aug-cc RIFIT aux exists for these elements upstream). RI aux only needs to span the OBS product space, so cross-zeta/cross-family aux is acceptable for GW100 expansion. Original aug-cc-pVDZ-RIFIT elements unchanged. Data from Turbomole 7.3
